title: No PRAGMA busy_timeout — concurrent kithctl reads get immediate SQLITE_BUSY
description: lib.rs::init_conn sets WAL and foreign_keys but not busy_timeout. A concurrent kithctl process opening the same DB file while kithd holds a write lock returns SQLITE_BUSY immediately with no retry. Fix: add 'PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000' to the execute_batch in init_conn so concurrent readers wait up to 5s.
